description.en: Turn the experience scattered across your projects into reusable knowledge assets, then hand it back at the moment it matters. Markdown source of truth plus a node:sqlite FTS5 index, entirely on your machine.
description.zh: 把散落在项目里的经验沉淀成可复用的知识资产，再在需要的那一刻交还给模型和开发者。Markdown 为事实来源，node:sqlite FTS5 只做索引，数据不出本机。

notes.en: dshmarket reads only the fields in plugins[] below. installCommand is informational: dshmarket itself installs the npm package from its own registry, the CLI line is for hosts without a marketplace (any profile except desktop).
notes.zh: dshmarket 只读下面 plugins[] 里的字段。installCommand 仅供人看：dshmarket 自己从它的 registry 装 npm 包，命令行那条是给没有市场的宿主用的（desktop 之外的 profile）。

description.en: Turn the experience scattered across your projects into reusable knowledge assets, then hand it back at the moment it matters. Markdown source of truth plus a node:sqlite FTS5 index, entirely on your machine.
description.zh: 把散落在项目里的经验沉淀成可复用的知识资产，再在需要的那一刻交还给模型和开发者。Markdown 为事实来源，node:sqlite FTS5 只做索引，数据不出本机。

installNote.en: Any profile except desktop; the desktop profile is owned by the app and installs through the marketplace UI.
installNote.zh: desktop 之外的 profile 用这条命令；desktop profile 由桌面应用独占，请走市场界面安装。
